The main takeaway from our work is that
the RLZ factorizations of strings can be computed on-line in time O(n log n), which is the same time bound that is required to compute the LZ factorization of a string.

the on-line RLZ factorization is not much more difficult to compute than the on-line Lempel-Zov factorization.
